meta.title: A 3D Bioprinted Human Neurovascular Unit Model of Glioblastoma Tumor Growth.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A neurovascular unit of primary human astrocytes, pericytes and brain endothelial cells was printed as a ring, with patient-derived glioblastoma cells printed at its centre, to follow tumour growth in a brain-like setting.

formulations.name: Fibrinogen + 6% gelatin (neurovascular ring + GBM dot)
formulations.composition_detail: 2.5-5 mg/mL fibrinogen with 6% gelatin and aprotinin; tumour dot in 6% gelatin (bioink C)
formulations.cell_type: astrocytes, pericytes, brain endothelial cells + JHH-520 GBM cells
formulations.key_outcome: The printed neurovascular unit let patient GBM cells grow in a brain-like microenvironment for tumour studies.

evidence.quote: These three types (A: 5 mg ml−1 fibrinogen with 6% gelatin and aprotinin.
A ring pattern was printed through with a 21G needle (inner diameter of 0.514 mm)
a dot pattern was printed at the center of the ring structure of NVU with JHH520 cells in 3 million cells ml−1 concentration in bioink‐C via 26G needle
